description: Build a floor-occupancy tracker scaffold for synthetic rehearsal, Ouster TOP, Leuze ROD4 CHOP, or UDP point input. Produces a tracked_points CHOP plus a floor preview TOP; hardware modes default inactive and remain explicitly unverified until a real sensor is connected.

active.description: Enable live hardware input immediately. Defaults false for rehearsal safety.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path to build inside.

sensor.description: Sensor scaffold to create. Hardware modes stay inactive by default.

sensor_address.description: IP address for Ouster/Leuze hardware modes.
